blocks.orig: Located within the Game Controlled Area of the Tanzanian Wildlife Authority (TAWA), Africa Safari Serengeti Ikoma is a great location to explore the Serengeti ecosystem at only 300 meters from the national park boundary. This spacious tented camp offers comfortable rooms with ensuite bathrooms with toilet and hot shower (solar-powered) and a private patio with tables and chairs from where you can enjoy the views. In the common areas, you can enjoy a buffet or à la carte menu at the restaurant, a drink at the lounge bar or by the campfire, or choose to have a go at the pool table or other games. It’s a lovely place to unwind between your exciting safari trips, and a great spot to continue game viewing, as the lodge has a proverbial backyard full of them, thanks to its proximity to the Grumeti River.
blocks.html: Just 300 meters from the national park boundary, inside the Game Controlled Area of the Tanzanian Wildlife Authority (TAWA), Africa Safari Serengeti Ikoma is well placed for exploring the Serengeti ecosystem. The spacious tented camp has comfortable rooms with ensuite bathrooms, each with a toilet and a hot shower (solar-powered), plus a private patio with a table and chairs for enjoying the views. In the shared areas you can choose a buffet or the à la carte menu in the restaurant, have a drink in the lounge bar or at the campfire, or try the pool table and other games. It’s a pleasant spot to relax between your safari outings, and a good place to keep watching wildlife too, since the nearby Grumeti River means the lodge has plenty of animals in its proverbial backyard.
